svg.text: 1 · Fire is the page's crew action, so it is a band above the catalogue (it was an 18 rem column beside it): the running loop with Stop loop and Skip to finale, then the item and Fire…. On a phone it comes first.

2 · Each group is one auto-fill grid of storyboard cards at least 18 rem wide: 3 columns at 1280 px, 5 at 1920 px, 1 on a phone. Fifteen cards fill rows that end level; every card's actions sit at its foot.

3 · Few: two of the event's own keep their card width. A card holds the name, its number and trigger, rounds and sound, its status, On or Off, and Turn on or off; Duplicate and Reset to default move into the ⋯ menu, so the card
4 · None: a group without cards says so in one dashed line with what to do; there is no empty grid.
5 · Order: the catalogue's numbers for built-ins, A to Z for the event's own. Turning one on or off, or a run starting, never moves a card.
